status: prospective software contract; confirmation text unopened and formal payload gate closed

allowed_confirmation_information: raw text used only by the fingerprint builder
result_blindness.operator_visibility: production builder emits hashes, counts and blinded document IDs only; it must not emit confirmation raw text

url_rule.parse: URL must be null or string; absolute HTTP(S) only; lowercase/IDNA DNS host or normalized bracketed IPv6; strip exactly one DNS root trailing dot and reject multiple; remove default port; retain path and query; drop fragment; a supplied but invalid URL is conservatively rejected
url_rule.publisher_block: reject host globalvoices.org or any of its subdomains
url_rule.exact_match: reject canonical URL equality against the confirmation index
url_rule.conservatism: no query-parameter deletion, www folding, redirect resolution or registrable-domain guessing

content_rule.normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, collapse every Unicode whitespace run to one ASCII space, strip ends
content_rule.exact: SHA256 of normalized UTF-8, compared only within canonical language
content_rule.near: Unicode word tokens; multiset of full 256-bit SHA256 five-word shingles; require both texts >=20 words and multiset containment intersection/min(shingle masses) >=0.80 within language
content_rule.candidate_generation: SQLite inverted shingle index with temp_store=FILE; exact verification uses integer multiset intersection
content_rule.short_text_policy: texts below 20 words receive exact matching only
content_rule.cross_language_policy: content hashes and shingles are language-scoped; URL/publisher rules remain language-independent

selector.storage: SQLite WAL with temp_store=FILE; raw rows are staged on disk; duplicate aggregation stays in SQL and accepted records are emitted as a stream rather than a Python list
selector.duplicates: two-pass stable-ID counts; every copy of a duplicate ID is rejected; missing ID is a dataset-wide hard failure
selector.rank: ascending SHA256(pa-bpe-train-v1\0language\0stable-id), then exact stable-ID UTF-8 bytes
selector.eligibility_order: schema/provenance, duplicate, corpus fields, publisher/exact/near decontamination, then rank
selector.restart: database binds protocol SHA256, implementation SHA256, strict/diagnostic provenance mode, training input-manifest SHA256 and confirmation-manifest SHA256; completed confirmation and row stages are idempotent across close/reopen, while any binding mismatch is a hard failure; emission requires every binding and both stage-complete flags
selector.atomic_manifest: stream accepted rows into a same-directory temporary JSON file, fsync file, os.replace, then fsync directory; nominal publish is tested, crash recovery remains unclaimed

verification_scope.research_data: already exposed English/French/Spanish first-row probes, used only for order equivalence and formal-provenance rejection
verification_scope.production_claim: none; this is a decontaminated ranked-row stream, not the pretoken-budget selector. Full GlobalVoices fingerprint construction, payload scan, row-to-shard truth, budget integration and production-scale qualification remain HOLD
